title: Session: 2.28.0 public suggestions
objective: 2.28.0 adds /suggest: members and guests post feature ideas as public GitHub issues, cleaned of links, mentions, emails and IDs. DevBot previews into the private reports repository. Limits: 1 an hour and 3 a day per member, 10 a day in total. No migration (schema 009 from 2.25.0); 21 roots / 46 paths. It follows 2.27.0, the documentation site (2.26.0 was skipped).
user: Run /suggest idea:<an idea of 10+ characters> as a member or guest: the reply links a preview issue in deconfined/tarubot-reports.
Open that issue: check the title, the fixed first line, the fenced text, 'Sent by TaruBot 2.28.0.' and the labels enhancement and from-discord.
Put a link, an @mention and a long ID in an idea: none of them appear in the issue. (Wait an hour, or use another account.)
Run /suggest again within the hour: 'You can suggest again later', with when.
Optional: an idea under 10 visible characters once invisible ones are removed gets 'Check your input' with the Example (Discord itself refuses anything under 10).
From an account without the Member or Guest role: 'FC membership needed', with steps to either role.
If a changelog channel is set: after the deploy, one post 'TaruBot updated to v2.28.0' with the /suggest note.
After the merge, read the site's two /suggest pages (Use TaruBot, Run a server) and flag anything unclear.
assistant: After the merge, confirm the Documentation site workflow published the /suggest pages.
Deploy 2.28.0 to DevBot with the owner's go-ahead (restart, no migration), register guild commands and read them back (21 roots / 46 paths).
With the go-ahead, put GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY in the production host's .env and refresh the settings copy.
Deploy to production, probe the GitHub App (expect 422, no issue created), then register.js --global and commands.js list (21 global).
Record the rollouts and the owner's test /suggest in docs/DEV_GUILD.md and docs/VERIFICATION.md.
bot: Run compiled 2.28.0 on the current schema with no migration.
Answer /suggest only in the test guild, for holders of the Member or Guest role, previewing into the reports repository.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in #chat.
